notes: Outcome: the news.uscg.mil feed address could not be confirmed with the tools available this hour; the entry in watch/sources.json should stay disabled. No repository file was edited. What was established: (1) The AFPIMS/ArticleCS pattern in the task is right. Sibling sites publish text copies of their feed URLs: MARFORRES lists ContentType=1 (News) and ContentType=2 (Press Releases) with Site=537; feeder.co shows navy.mil ContentType=2&Site=1067 as a working feed; rsscatalog lists CENTCOM Site=808; a search result shows a www.uscg.mil biographies feed with Site=782,824 (not opened). Site ids are single numbers in the hundreds to low thousands, so 1041 is plausible but unverified. Because news.uscg.mil labels its items 'Press Release', the right feed may be ContentType=2 rather than 1; both should be tested. (2) Search engines match the string 'RSS.ashx' on many news.uscg.mil pages (home, district pages, Press-Releases), so the site does expose an RSS.ashx link, but the fetch tool drops every link address when it converts a page, so the href with the Site id could not be read. (3) Every RSS.ashx endpoint tried, including four known-good ones on other AFPIMS sites, returned a fetch error, as did news.uscg.mil/robots.txt and /sitemap.aspx, while ordinary HTML pages opened. The platform appears to block this fetcher on non-page handlers; the failure of the Site=1041 URL is therefore not evidence that the id is wrong, and the watch's GitHub Actions fetch may or may not meet the same block. (4) Feed proxies were blocked by robots rules or needed a permission that was not granted in time. (5) HTML listings returned by the fetch tool carried stale dates on a 2026-10-15 run (home: May 19, 2025; Press-Releases: Sept 2, 2025; All-News: May 9, 2026), so no newest-item date could be confirmed even from HTML. (6) Alternative, confirmed-live Coast Guard feed: GovDelivery topic USDHSCG_164, 'U.S. Coast Guard Seventh District Southeast News', newest item about 19 hours old per feeder.co on 2026-10-15. It is regional, and public.govdelivery.com disallows robots, which may matter for the watch job. The 'Subscribe to CG News' email link on news.uscg.mil suggests a national GovDelivery topic exists; its id was not found. NAVCEN's 58 GovDelivery feeds are notices to mariners, not news. Recommendation: a person with a browser can open https://www.news.uscg.mil/, view the page source, search for 'RSS.ashx' and read the Site and ContentType values in under a minute, then paste the URL into a feed reader to confirm items and the newest date. That is the missing step.
